title: The type of '…' can't be inferred because it depends on itself through the cycle: ….
summary: Try adding an explicit type to one or more of the variables in the cycle in order to break the cycle.
message_templates: The type of '{}' can't be inferred because it depends on itself through the cycle: {}.

title: Operators must be declared within a class.
summary: Try removing the operator, moving it to a class, or converting it to be a function.
message_templates: Operators must be declared within a class.
